arguments.question: For the next 21 and 63 sessions, use the latest Federal Reserve FOMC statement and projections to identify the current policy stance, any change in the policy rate or balance-sheet policy, and stated inflation/employment/growth risks relevant to broad duration-sensitive technology equities. Address only a defensible transmission to NVIDIA: whether issuer disclosure provides a measured linkage from policy/financial conditions to AI-infrastructure customer capex, and explicitly state if it does not. Do not infer a numerical valuation or earnings impact. Stop after the latest FOMC materials and any directly relevant official policy release; cite evidence IDs.
arguments.decision_impact: This tests the material company–macro question: whether a monetary-policy-driven change in financial conditions can be tied, using disclosed NVIDIA exposure, to near-term AI-infrastructure demand or instead only supports a broad SPY/XLK relative-risk context.
